title: En la ferretería
desc: Buying a thing whose name you do not know
setting: You need a specific bolt and you do not have the word for it in any language.

steps.speaker: Vendedor
steps.en: Afternoon. How can I help you?

options.es: Buenas. Ando buscando una cosa, pero no sé cómo se llama.
options.en: Afternoon. I am looking for something, but I do not know what it is called.
options.feedback: The honest opening. Half of what a ferretería sells is the name of the thing.
If it really is a screw, good. If not, you have sent him to the wrong drawer.
You came in for something. Now you have to start again.

steps.speaker: Vendedor
steps.es: Dígame cómo es y yo se lo busco.
steps.en: Tell me what it is like and I will find it for you.

options.es: Es de metal, redondo, y va en la pila para el agua.
options.en: It is metal, round, and goes on the tank for the water.
options.feedback: Material, shape, and where it goes. That is enough for anybody behind that counter.
Half the shop is small and metal. Say where it goes.

options.en: It is like the other one.
options.feedback: He has not seen the other one. Describe this one.

steps.speaker: Vendedor
steps.es: Ah, ya sé cuál es. ¿De media pulgada o de una?
steps.en: Ah, I know which one. Half an inch or one inch?

options.es: No sé, fíjese. ¿Me puede enseñar los dos?
options.en: I do not know, look. Can you show me both?
options.feedback: Fíjese buys you a second and admits what you do not know. He offered - take the offer.
A guess. He offered to show you and you turned it down.
He asked you to choose between two, not a yes or no.

steps.speaker: Vendedor
steps.es: Este es el que le sirve. Lleve dos por si acaso.
steps.en: This is the one you want. Take two just in case.

options.en: Good idea. Give me two then.
options.feedback: You took the advice of the man who knows, which is the whole point of the shop.
It might be. Around here the second one saves the second trip.
You came in without the word for it. He was helping.
